'''Winsafra Jedi Training, lemme know what you guys think please''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 9 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 MWYHL Winsafra LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Bacta Tank and Jedi's resiliance? just a necessary for this deck. makes bombs discusting. and just enough space to wreak havoc before Guri gets out :P

The published list has 57 cards.
